header.importHint: Start styles from a Nexus Commerce export file, or a sheet in its columns

importer.name: Styles from a Nexus Commerce export
importer.fills: One row per SKU, as Nexus Commerce exports a product family: each family becomes a draft style with its colours, sizes, SKU codes and barcodes. Nothing is sent to Nexus Commerce.

source.title: Start from a Nexus Commerce product
source.subtitle: Draft styles from the product families of an export file
source.label: Where the styles come from

file.title: Export file from Nexus Commerce
file.hint: CSV or Excel, one row per SKU, up to {max} rows. A bigger export goes in parts, a whole family in each part.

reason.OWNER_WORD: Waits for the Owner's word: for now the factory reads an export file only, and has no link to Nexus Commerce.

makes.title: What the import makes
makes.family: Each product family becomes a draft style in Concept, with revision 1 as a draft.
makes.colours: Its colours become colourways and its sizes the range, on the size scale that holds them.
makes.skus: The SKU codes and EAN barcodes stay as they are in Nexus Commerce.
makes.again: You see every row in a dry run first; the same file again changes nothing.
makes.nothingBack: Nothing is written to Nexus Commerce.

how.title: How to get the file
how.export: In Nexus Commerce, export the products with their variants: SKU, Parent SKU, name, colour, size and EAN, with the category and season if you have them.
how.columns: Or download the template in the next step and fill it in the same columns.

hold.noManage: Your role can view styles, not start them.
hold.noImport: Importing a file needs the right to run imports (imports.run) and to upload files.
hold.reading: Reading where the styles can come from…
hold.unread: Where the styles can come from could not be read: try again.

fault.signed_out: You are signed out: sign in again.
fault.not_found: This import was not found, or your role cannot see it.
fault.unavailable: The factory cannot be reached just now: try again in a moment.
fault.rate_limited: Too many requests at once: try again in a moment.
fault.internal: Something went wrong on our side: try again.

done.title: Styles from the Nexus Commerce file

none.title: No style was written
none.body: Every row was already in the factory, or refused: Admin › Import & export keeps the import with its rows.

done.unreadHint: The import is done: the styles are in the list.
done.next: Each new style is a draft: set its PPE category, base size, BOM and routing on the style.
